claims.text: The driver never reached the pickup point on the platform's own telemetry. Across 79 fixes spanning 23:10:40 to 23:23:40, the closest the driver's device ever came to the pin at Clarke Quay was 623.57 m (mean 823.00 m, worst 1625.98 m). The arrival radius for this trip's zone class, LARGE_VENUE, is 120 m. There is not a single fix inside it: qualifying_fix_count is 0. POL-NS-01 limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the POL-NS-02 geofence at or before the 'arrived' event, and it does not, at any point in the 15 minutes before the 23:24:10 cancellation. Limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable.

Even setting arrival aside, POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails: the dwell is zero. The trace records no in-geofence interval at all - qualifying_fix_count is 0, run_count is 0, longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0, and accumulated_dwell.accumulated_sec is 0.0 - against a minimum_dwell_sec of 300 for LARGE_VENUE. The 9 minutes of 'wait' in the trip record is a record of driving, not of waiting: the driver's distinct speeds on this trace run from 28.1 to 30.6 kph over 2.11 km of travel. With limb (b) and limb (c) both broken, POL-NS-01 cannot carry the fee.

The 'arrived' marker at 23:15:10 is a false marker on both independent triggers in POL-NS-05. Distance: the trace's minimum distance across the whole trip is 623.57 m, so at the marker the driver was at least 623 m out, more than double the 300 m trigger. Motion: the same trace records sustained speeds of 28.1 to 30.6 kph, well above the 15 kph trigger, i.e. the vehicle was travelling, not holding at a kerb. The waiting clock must therefore be recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix - and there is none. Under POL-NS-05(ii) the cancellation fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and this trip must be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list.

POL-NS-06 gives the same result independently: the effective in-geofence dwell, computed under POL-NS-02 and corrected under POL-NS-05, is 0 seconds against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE - a shortfall of 300 seconds. POL-NS-06(ii) is explicit that a shortfall refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded. The one qualification, limb (i) accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals, is unavailable twice over: there are no separate intervals to accumulate (run_count 0), and there is no traffic advisory on file at all. EV-ADVIS-00627-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, and a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable rather than exonerating anyone.

The driver cannot fall back on POL-NS-03. That clause reaches only a driver who was stationary for the required dwell at a point outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin. The 400 m ceiling is measured from trip_record.pickup, and this driver's minimum distance was 623.57 m - he was never inside it. There are no stationary fixes within 400 m, no venue_id on the pickup to corroborate a same-venue mislocation, and no chat message from either party naming an entrance, block or bay. This is not a wrong-entrance case; it is a driver who was not at the venue.

The rider was at the pin, and was there for the whole window. The rider track carries 64 fixes from 23:14:40 to 23:24:07, every one of them qualifying, with a mean distance of 12.90 m from the pin and a maximum of 17.62 m - comfortably inside the 150 m rider presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, and identical in count to rider_qualifying_fix_count (64). The driver's statement that 'the passenger wasn't visible' is therefore contradicted by the platform's own device telemetry of the rider's device.

On POL-NS-04, limbs (b) and (c) are met squarely. Limb (b): the rider messaged at 23:16:40; the driver's last and only message was at 23:16:30, and the driver posted nothing after it, so no reply came within 120 seconds. The only in-app call in trip_record.in_app_calls was placed by the RIDER at 23:15:40, not by the driver, and was answered for 40 seconds - so the call limb of (b) is not triggered against the rider either. Limb (c): 64 of 64 rider fixes within 150 m. On limb (a), I put the rider's position candidly: the rider's message is 'no, you cancel', which coordinates the resolution of the pickup but is not one of the enumerated location statements. The enumerated list reads as illustrative of 'locating or coordinating', and the rider was in fact at the pin; but if the Judge reads limb (a) as confined to the listed location content, this claim falls away and nothing else in the case depends on it, because POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each dispose of the fee on the GPS trace alone.

The trip record is impaired and I disclose it: EV-TRIP-00627 carries weight_multiplier 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR), the pre-pass having found that its arrived_at of 23:15:10 and its wait_time_min of 9.0 are contradicted by the GPS positions over the same interval - the trace places the vehicle about 750 m from the pin throughout the claimed in-geofence wait. Under POL-GEN-02(1) I name the impairment rather than present it as clean. Its effect is limited: the deciding fact here, how far the driver was from the pin, rests on EV-GPS-00627, which is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and on the rider track in the same artifact. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is the maximum of the weights on the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, so the cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not engaged. The trip record's contradicted figures are the only support for the charge, and at 0.4 they cannot alone carry a finding for the driver under POL-NS-08.

This case should be decided, not escalated. POL-NS-09(b) requires two admissible artifacts contradicting each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence AND no clause resolving the conflict. Here a clause does resolve it: POL-NS-02 makes arrival a GPS geofence test and POL-NS-05 is drafted precisely to decide, from the trace, whether an arrival marker is false. The resolution is one-directional and leaves no open question. The repeat-behaviour and abuse triggers are also absent on the profiles: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so POL-NS-09(c) does not fire; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) does not fire; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch cannot fire either, at 1 termination against 110 completed trips in 30 days.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays at 80 percent of the cancellation fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (b) and (c), and POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-06 each direct independently that on a false marker or a shortfall the fee is refunded with no compensation. The fare_breakdown's own derived block computes a driver_compensation of 4.80, but that figure is conditional on a fee that was never chargeable, and it must not be emitted.

The driver's own message is an admission against his written statement. At 23:16:30, one minute after he marked 'arrived', he wrote 'car problem, you cancel' - the words of a driver who could not perform the trip and wanted the rider to absorb the cancellation, not of a driver who had arrived and could not park. His counterparty statement says there was no parking so he circled; the trace shows circling at 28 to 30 kph between 623 m and 1626 m from the pin, with no stationary interval inside the geofence and no advisory on file to make holding position lawfully impossible. The trip was in substance terminated by the driver for his own reason, which is not any of the three reason codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and limb (d) additionally requires termination at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed - a moment that never came.

The amount in issue is clean and the refund is the whole of it. The fare_breakdown charges a cancellation_fee of SGD 6.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That reconciles with fee_schedule: the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (6.00) is 6.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and no reason to discount the figure. Under POL-GEN-03 the filing party is the RIDER and the contested amount is 6.00, so a full refund returns the entire contested sum, with no driver compensation to net against it.

POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are made out on the platform's own trip record: EV-TRIP-00627 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 23:15:10 and records the trip as terminated by the driver at 23:24:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) recognises - status CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER and no boarding event. I do not contend limbs (b) and (c) are made out on the GPS trace as it stands; those limbs turn on which of two directly conflicting sources governs, which I address below. I disclose that EV-TRIP-00627 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.4, issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR), its arrived_at and wait_time_min being contradicted by the trace's positions over the same interval.

Two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell, and on this record the conflict is unresolved: EV-TRIP-00627 reports a 9.0-minute in-geofence wait inside the LARGE_VENUE 120 m radius, while EV-GPS-00627 never places the vehicle closer than 623.57 m to the pin (mean 822.99 m, max 1,625.98 m) across the identical 23:10:40 to 23:23:40 window, with 79 fixes at 28.1 to 30.6 km/h. This is the very fact pattern POL-NS-09(b) states in terms - a trip record asserting an in-geofence dwell while the trace holds the driver some 800 m from the pin throughout the same interval - and the admissibility pre-pass has already tagged it CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR). The disputed SGD 6.00 should therefore be held for a human reviewer rather than refunded by the automated pipeline. I note that limb (c) is not the route: no counter shows a second dispute between these parties, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d being 0. EV-TRIP-00627 is impaired at weight 0.4 on CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR), as disclosed above.

POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact that carries the deciding fact. On the reading I advance, the deciding fact is the driver's arrival and dwell, and the only artifact asserting it is EV-TRIP-00627, impaired at weight 0.4 on issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR). No ruling resting on that artifact can carry confidence above 0.4, which is below the 0.70 floor that POL-GEN-02 and POL-NS-09(a) share; the case must escalate and the fee must be held rather than collected or refunded. Neither artifact is attacked as fabricated here - it is the platform's own cross-source conflict that leaves the arrival fact undecidable.

In the alternative, if the Judge rules on the merits and credits the trip record - the only source that says the driver arrived and waited - POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to SGD 4.80, being 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee itemised in EV-FARE-00627, with the rider's charge standing. The anti-farming check does not trip on the citable counters: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.009, below the 0.08 rate, so compensation is not withheld. I disclose again that this branch rests on EV-TRIP-00627, impaired at weight 0.4 on CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR).

The rider's second and only substantive message does not engage POL-NS-04 limb (a). 'no, you cancel' states no position of hers, names no entrance, block, tower or bay, asks the driver for no position, and does not say she cannot see the vehicle; it is a refusal to cancel, not the locating or coordinating content limb (a) enumerates. The rider-exoneration route is therefore not opened by the chat log, and the rider's case must stand or fall on POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05 against the trace.

The SGD 6.00 charged is the correct figure under the schedule and admits of no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity objection: fee_schedule.resolution_rule takes the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00), which is SGD 6.00, and that is exactly the cancellation_fee line itemised in EV-FARE-00627, produced on the vehicle_tier dimension. Whatever disposition follows, the sum in issue is SGD 6.00 and it is properly itemised, so the amount to be held or refunded is not in dispute.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00627 is refunded in full to the rider; no driver compensation is payable.

WHY THE FEE CANNOT STAND. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold. The driver's 'arrived' event (limb (a)) and the driver-side RIDER_NO_SHOW termination (limb (d)) are on the trip record, and the Driver Advocate expressly does not contend limbs (b) and (c) are made out. On the platform's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00627, weight_multiplier 1.0, COMPLETE: 79 fixes at 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps), the vehicle never came closer than 623.57 m to the Clarke Quay pin (mean 822.99 m; worst 1,625.98 m) between 23:10:40 and 23:23:40, and it was travelling at 28.1-30.6 km/h. qualifying_fix_count is 0, run_count is 0 and the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 s against the 300 s minimum for LARGE_VENUE. Limbs (b) and (c) both fail, and because the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes before the 23:24:10 cancellation, POL-NS-02 gives the rider a full refund of the fee.

THE DRIVER ADVOCATE'S CONTRARY ARGUMENTS FAIL. (1) Limbs (a) and (d) alone cannot carry the fee; all four are required, and two are conceded absent. (2) The POL-NS-09(b) escalation is rejected: that limb fires only where NO clause resolves the cross-source conflict, and POL-NS-01(b) and POL-NS-02 make the GPS trace the arrival test (with POL-NS-05 the false-marker test), which resolves the conflict in one direction and leaves no open question. No other POL-NS-09 trigger fires. (3) The POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0, not 0.4: the deciding fact — that the driver never entered the geofence — is carried by EV-GPS-00627 at weight 1.0, and the ruling does not rest on the trip record. EV-TRIP-00627 is impaired (weight_multiplier 0.4, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR)); its arrived_at of 23:15:10 and 9.0-minute wait_time_min are precisely the contradicted figures and are outweighed by the trace; per POL-GEN-02(3) the finding survives the discount because it does not depend on that artifact. (4) Driver compensation is refused: POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied IN FULL, which it is not, so the SGD 4.80 computed in the fare_breakdown's derived block is not emitted. POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route is unavailable — it needs stationary dwell within 400 m of the pin, and the nearest approach was 623.57 m with no stationary interval, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so there is no pin-ambiguity goodwill either. The driver's account ('no parking, I circled') is what the trace shows: circling at 28-30 km/h up to 1.6 km away, with no advisory on file (EV-ADVIS-00627-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so POL-NS-06(i) cannot make the separate stretches summable. (5) The rider's message 'no, you cancel' is not a locating or coordinating message, so POL-NS-04 does not apply; the refund does not depend on it. The rider's own device telemetry (64 qualifying fixes, mean 12.90 m from the pin, max 17.62 m) confirms the rider was at the pin throughout.

THE AMOUNT. The SGD 6.00 is the fee_schedule resolution-rule figure — the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) — and reconciles with the fare_breakdown cancellation_fee line, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The entire contested sum of SGD 6.00 is returned.

CONFIDENCE. The ruling rests on EV-GPS-00627 (weight 1.0) for the non-arrival and zero dwell, and on EV-FARE-00627 (weight 1.0) for the amount; the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is therefore 1.0, and confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor shared by POL-NS-09(a) and POL-GEN-02.

REFERRAL. ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 6.00 no-show fee is refunded to the rider in full.

What the record shows. There are two accounts of this pickup, and the platform's own GPS trace decides between them. Across 79 fixes from 23:10:40 to 23:23:40, driver DRV-32752's device never came closer than 623.57 m to the pin at Clarke Quay (mean 822.99 m, worst 1,625.98 m), and the vehicle was travelling at 28.1 to 30.6 km/h. The LARGE_VENUE arrival radius is 120 m. The rider's device, by contrast, was at the pin: 64 of 64 fixes from 23:14:40 to 23:24:07, a mean of 12.90 m and a maximum of 17.62 m from it, well inside the 150 m rider-presence radius.

Why the fee cannot stand. POL-NS-01 needs all four of its conditions. (a) is formally present — the trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 23:15:10 — and limb (d)'s RIDER_NO_SHOW code is present, but limb (b) fails outright: the trace never places the driver inside the 120 m geofence, so qualifying_fix_count is 0 and there is no in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes before the 23:24:10 cancellation. Limb (c) fails too: the measured in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE (longest qualifying run 0.0 s, run count 0). A charge that needs both (b) and (c) cannot be sustained.

POL-NS-05 makes the same point from the marker. Its two independent triggers both fire at 23:15:10: the vehicle was more than 300 m from the pin (it was at least 623 m away at every point in the window) and it was travelling at well above 15 km/h. The 'arrived' tap is therefore a false marker and does not start the waiting clock. The clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and there is none, so POL-NS-05(ii) directs a full refund, no compensation, and a false-arrival record. POL-NS-06 reaches the same place arithmetically: a 0-second dwell against a 300-second minimum is a 300-second shortfall, and the only qualification — summing separate in-geofence intervals — is unavailable, because there are no intervals and no traffic advisory on file (EV-ADVIS-00627-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0). The driver's own message, 'car problem, you cancel' at 23:16:30, is consistent with this and not with a driver held up by parking; his counterparty statement ('no parking, so I circled') is not supported, the trace showing circling 623 m to 1,626 m from the pin with no stationary interval inside the geofence.

The driver's arguments, answered together.
- The trip record's 9-minute wait: EV-TRIP-00627 does say the driver arrived at 23:15:10 and waited 9.0 minutes, and the driver disclosed its impairment — weight_multiplier 0.4, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR), its arrived_at and wait_time_min being contradicted by the trace over the same interval. At 0.4, and contradicted, it cannot carry the charge.
- Escalation under POL-NS-09(b) is refused. That limb needs two admissible artifacts in direct conflict and NO clause able to resolve it. Here the policy resolves it: POL-NS-02 makes arrival a GPS geofence test, and POL-NS-05 is written precisely to decide, from the trace, whether an arrival marker is false. Being able to decide a conflict is not the same as being unable to.
- The argument that the confidence cap is 0.4 is refused. The deciding fact — how far the vehicle was from the pin — is carried by EV-GPS-00627, which is COMPLETE at weight 1.0; the trip record asserts the opposite and carries nothing. The cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is not engaged.
- Driver compensation of SGD 4.80 is refused. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-01 fails, and POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-06 each direct a full refund with no compensation. The anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination against 110 completed trips in 30 days), but there is nothing to compensate.
- The rider's POL-NS-04 contact route is not needed. Her message 'no, you cancel' is not clearly one of the locating statements limb (a) lists, so the ruling does not rest on it; the fee falls under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 on the trace alone.

No escalation. Confidence is above the floor; the profiles show no repeat dispute between these two parties (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0) and no abuse trigger (rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and a single no-show termination is well below the POL-NS-07 threshold); and the deciding GPS trace is not impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d) — no clock skew, no sampling gap, the chat log is complete at 2 messages matching the trip record, and the SGD 6.00 line reconciles with the fee schedule.

Amount: SGD 6.00, the cancellation fee itemised in EV-FARE-00627 (total_charged 6.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), which reconciles with the fee schedule — the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00). No driver compensation is paid. A referral records the false arrival against the driver.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The disputed SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable.

WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if all four of its conditions hold. The platform's GPS trace (EV-GPS-00627, COMPLETE, weight 1.0) decides two of them against the charge. Across 79 fixes from 23:10:40 to 23:23:40 the driver's device never came closer than 623.57 m to the pickup pin (mean 822.99 m, worst 1,625.98 m). The arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup is 120 m, and the qualifying in-geofence fix count is 0, so limb (b) fails. The in-geofence dwell is also 0 seconds (accumulated_dwell 0.0, longest_qualifying_run 0.0, run_count 0) against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE, so limb (c) fails. POL-NS-02 therefore gives the rider a full refund of the cancellation fee, and POL-NS-06 gives the same result on a 300-second shortfall.

The 'arrived' marker was false. At its timestamp the trace places the vehicle more than 300 m out and travelling at 28.1–30.6 km/h, above the 15 km/h trigger, so POL-NS-05 applies; and because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full and directs that the trip be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver — that direction is in the referrals. POL-NS-03 does not apply: it reaches only a driver stationary within 400 m of the pin, and this driver's minimum distance was 623.57 m, so there is no pin-ambiguity goodwill payment either.

DRIVER'S ARGUMENTS. Limbs (a) and (d) of POL-NS-01 being made out on the trip record is accepted, but the clause is conjunctive and falls at (b) and (c). The POL-NS-09(b) escalation argument is rejected: the ground requires that no clause resolve the conflict, and POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05 resolve it — arrival and dwell are decided on the gps_trace, which is COMPLETE. The POL-GEN-02(2) argument that confidence caps at 0.4 is rejected: the deciding fact, that the driver never entered the geofence and never dwelled, is carried by EV-GPS-00627 at weight 1.0. The alternative claim for SGD 4.80 under POL-NS-07 fails because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 displace it; the anti-farming figures (1 termination against 110 completed trips) are correct but do not matter here.

RIDER'S POL-NS-04 CLAIM. Limb (c) is satisfied (64 of 64 rider fixes within the 150 m radius, mean 12.90 m, max 17.62 m), but limb (a) is not engaged — 'no, you cancel' is not one of the locating or coordinating statements the clause enumerates — so POL-NS-04 does not apply. Nothing turns on this; POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 dispose of the fee on the trace alone.

EVIDENCE WEIGHT. EV-TRIP-00627 is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.4 on issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR), its arrived_at and wait_time_min being contradicted by the trace. That is a POL-GEN-02 down-weight; the impairment does not meet POL-NS-08 limbs (a)–(d), so it is named but does not carry the case and does not trigger escalation. The refund rests on EV-GPS-00627 at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor.

AMOUNT. EV-FARE-00627 (weight 1.0) itemises a cancellation_fee of SGD 6.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, which reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 6.00 RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee is SGD 6.00, produced on the vehicle_tier dimension), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The whole SGD 6.00 is refunded, driver compensation is nil, and per POL-GEN-03 nothing is netted against the refund.

NO ESCALATION. None of POL-NS-09(a)–(e) fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the conflict is resolved by clause, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, no_show_disputes_30d is 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the deciding evidence is not impaired.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is paid to the driver.

The fee can stand only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, and two of them fail. Limb (b) requires the GPS trace to place the driver inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius of 120 m at or before the 23:15:10 'arrived' marker. Across 79 fixes from 23:10:40 to 23:23:40 the vehicle's closest approach to the pin was 623.57 m (mean 822.99 m, furthest 1,625.98 m), and the count of qualifying in-geofence fixes is 0. Limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence hold of 300 seconds; the measured dwell is 0 seconds, a shortfall of 300 seconds. The trip record does record an 'arrived' event and the RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code (limb (a) and part of limb (d)), but limb (d) also requires termination at or after the dwell elapsed, which never came, and the marker was in any event false: it was set with the vehicle more than 300 m out and moving at 28.1–30.6 km/h, so both POL-NS-05 triggers fire, and because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full. POL-NS-06 gives the identical result on the numbers alone — 0 seconds of dwell against a 300-second minimum. The one qualification, summing separate in-geofence intervals, is unavailable: there were no separate intervals and no traffic advisory is on file, EV-ADVIS-00627-01 being MISSING at weight 0.0.

The driver's request that the case be escalated is refused. POL-NS-09(b) fires only where the conflicting artifacts are not resolved by a clause; here a clause does resolve them, because POL-NS-02 makes arrival a GPS geofence test and POL-NS-05 is drafted to decide from the trace whether an arrival marker is false. The trip record is impaired — EV-TRIP-00627, weight 0.4, issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR) — and I name that impairment; but the deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-00627, which is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and POL-NS-09(a) and (e) do not fire. No repeat-dispute or abuse trigger is met either: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the driver's 1 no-show termination against 110 completed trips is far below the anti-farming thresholds.

No compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it — POL-NS-01 fails, and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 displace it, each directing that no compensation is due. The fare ledger's derived figure of SGD 4.80 is conditional on a fee that was never chargeable and is not emitted. POL-NS-03 does not apply: it needs the driver stationary within 400 m of the pin, and the minimum distance was 623.57 m.

On the rider's side, her presence at the pin is established on the platform's own telemetry — 64 fixes, mean 12.90 m, maximum 17.62 m, all inside the 150 m rider radius. I do not need to decide whether her 'no, you cancel' message engages POL-NS-04(a) as locating or coordinating content, because the refund follows from the GPS trace whichever way that reads.

The amount is correct and is not discounted: SGD 6.00 is the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00), which matches the cancellation-fee line in the ledger, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. SGD 6.00 is the whole contested sum, and it is returned.
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii) — record trip TRP-00627 as a false-arrival event against driver DRV-32752: the 'arrived' marker was set at 23:15:10 with the vehicle at least 623.57 m from the pin and travelling at 28.1–30.6 km/h, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are made out on the platform's own trip record: EV-TRIP-00627 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 23:15:10 and records the trip as terminated by the driver at 23:24:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) recognises - status CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER and no boarding event. I do not contend limbs (b) and (c) are made out on the GPS trace as it stands; those limbs turn on which of two directly conflicting sources governs, which I address below. I disclose that EV-TRIP-00627 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.4, issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR), its arrived_at and wait_time_min being contradicted by the trace's positions over the same interval.

Two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell, and on this record the conflict is unresolved: EV-TRIP-00627 reports a 9.0-minute in-geofence wait inside the LARGE_VENUE 120 m radius, while EV-GPS-00627 never places the vehicle closer than 623.57 m to the pin (mean 822.99 m, max 1,625.98 m) across the identical 23:10:40 to 23:23:40 window, with 79 fixes at 28.1 to 30.6 km/h. This is the very fact pattern POL-NS-09(b) states in terms - a trip record asserting an in-geofence dwell while the trace holds the driver some 800 m from the pin throughout the same interval - and the admissibility pre-pass has already tagged it CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR). The disputed SGD 6.00 should therefore be held for a human reviewer rather than refunded by the automated pipeline. I note that limb (c) is not the route: no counter shows a second dispute between these parties, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d being 0. EV-TRIP-00627 is impaired at weight 0.4 on CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR), as disclosed above.

POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact that carries the deciding fact. On the reading I advance, the deciding fact is the driver's arrival and dwell, and the only artifact asserting it is EV-TRIP-00627, impaired at weight 0.4 on issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR). No ruling resting on that artifact can carry confidence above 0.4, which is below the 0.70 floor that POL-GEN-02 and POL-NS-09(a) share; the case must escalate and the fee must be held rather than collected or refunded. Neither artifact is attacked as fabricated here - it is the platform's own cross-source conflict that leaves the arrival fact undecidable.

In the alternative, if the Judge rules on the merits and credits the trip record - the only source that says the driver arrived and waited - POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to SGD 4.80, being 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee itemised in EV-FARE-00627, with the rider's charge standing. The anti-farming check does not trip on the citable counters: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.009, below the 0.08 rate, so compensation is not withheld. I disclose again that this branch rests on EV-TRIP-00627, impaired at weight 0.4 on CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (MAJOR).

The rider's second and only substantive message does not engage POL-NS-04 limb (a). 'no, you cancel' states no position of hers, names no entrance, block, tower or bay, asks the driver for no position, and does not say she cannot see the vehicle; it is a refusal to cancel, not the locating or coordinating content limb (a) enumerates. The rider-exoneration route is therefore not opened by the chat log, and the rider's case must stand or fall on POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05 against the trace.

The SGD 6.00 charged is the correct figure under the schedule and admits of no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity objection: fee_schedule.resolution_rule takes the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00), which is SGD 6.00, and that is exactly the cancellation_fee line itemised in EV-FARE-00627, produced on the vehicle_tier dimension. Whatever disposition follows, the sum in issue is SGD 6.00 and it is properly itemised, so the amount to be held or refunded is not in dispute.
